verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents deployment tracking via an API, CLI and Capistrano integration (corroborated by a community user). Its stated purpose is to 'correlate code changes with errors', and it links revisions to a GitHub/GitLab diff since the last deploy. Errors can also be searched by `occurred.after:'last deploy'`. Missing for 10: evidence that each issue displays the release it first appeared in, any suspect-commit identification per issue, and release tagging on individual error notices.
